## ✨ Highlights

janusd no longer grows on nodes running BIRD or keepalived, cluster
members no longer raise the certificate alert for nothing, and
node_exporter carries its HTTP/2 fixes.

- 🐛 **No more memory leak in janusd**: on a node with the bird or
  keepalived extension, janusd took about 10 or 5 MiB more each hour,
  until a reboot - 1.6 GiB of 2 after six days on a production cluster.
- 🔐 **Member certificates renewed before the alert**: a cluster's
  members renew theirs with 15 days left, no longer 10 - the example
  `JanusCertificateExpiresSoon` alert, at 14 days, now fires only when a
  renewal failed.
- 🔒 **node_exporter 1.13.0**.

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- **Nodes with the bird or keepalived extension**: update them. Until
  then, `janusctl -n NODE system restart` (or **Restart janusd** on the
  node's Power page) gives the memory back without stopping HAProxy - its
  routes or virtual IPs go to the peers for the few seconds BIRD or
  keepalived restart. One node at a time.
- **Clusters**: once the Controller runs this release, every member
  whose certificate has less than 15 days left is renewed at the next
  check (within 10 minutes, or **Check now** on the cluster's page) - a
  `JanusCertificateExpiresSoon` raised for one clears then. A cluster
  without a Controller gets it from the next `janusctl cluster check`.

## 🔒 Security

- **Prometheus node_exporter 1.12.1 → 1.13.0** (nodes with the
  prometheus-node-exporter extension)
  ([#681](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/681)): fixes for Go's
  HTTP/2 server and transport in the modules it's built with - flow
  control ([CVE-2026-78663](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6612),
  critical), memory exhaustion by trailers
  ([CVE-2026-78659](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6603)), malformed
  framing headers
  ([CVE-2026-78660](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6610)), CPU on
  repeated window changes
  ([CVE-2026-78669](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6611)), an HPACK
  encoder race ([CVE-2026-97032](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6617)).
  Janus runs node_exporter over plain HTTP, where Go serves no HTTP/2:
  as Janus configures it, these don't reach it. Update the nodes all the
  same.

## 🔗 Clusters

- **Member certificates renewed at half their life**
  ([#683](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/683)): the certificates
  of the cluster's own TLS between members (stick tables, the
  connection handoff) last 30 days and were renewed with 10 days left,
  while the `JanusCertificateExpiresSoon` alert Janus gives as an
  example ([Alerts](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/metrics.md#alerts))
  fires at 14: every member of every cluster raised it four days each
  cycle. They're renewed with 15 days left now - by the Controller, and
  by `janusctl cluster check` for a cluster without one - a day before
  the alert, which then means a renewal failed. The node takes the new
  certificate without reloading HAProxy, as before.

## 🐛 Fixes

- **janusd's memory on nodes with BIRD or keepalived**
  ([#682](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/682)): the health gates
  that withdraw a node's routes (BIRD, every second) or give up its
  virtual IPs (keepalived, every two) while HAProxy doesn't answer or the
  member is drained left a waiting goroutine behind at each check, about
  3 KiB each - for good. Since v2026.10.24, janusd grew about 10 MiB an
  hour with BIRD and 5 MiB with keepalived, until the node rebooted;
  on a 2 GiB cluster member, 1.68 GiB six days after its last update,
  133 MiB left available. One wait per change now, gone when it fires.
  Nodes with neither extension weren't concerned.
